description: Project scaffold with Next.js 15, Biome linting, graphify task tracker, and core dependencies. This establishes the monorepo structure, installs all dependencies from the product spec, configures Biome (not ESLint), sets up the graphify.json task dependency graph for tracking progress, and creates the base configuration files.
steps: Initialize Next.js 15 project with App Router and TypeScript in /projects/sandbox/LDO_rahul using 'npx create-next-app@latest . --typescript --tailwind --app --src-dir --import-alias @/* --no-eslint --turbopack' (answer yes to all prompts, use --no-eslint since we use Biome)

Install core dependencies: @trpc/server @trpc/client @trpc/react-query @trpc/next @tanstack/react-query drizzle-orm drizzle-kit pg zod zustand react-hook-form @hookform/resolvers next-auth@beta bullmq ioredis sharp recharts framer-motion @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable @dnd-kit/utilities lucide-react sonner next-themes class-variance-authority clsx tailwind-merge
Install dev dependencies: @biomejs/biome vitest @vitejs/plugin-react @testing-library/react @testing-library/jest-dom jsdom @types/pg typescript @types/node
Remove any default ESLint config (.eslintrc*, eslint.config.*) and replace with Biome config at biome.json with recommended rules, TypeScript support, format on save settings, and organize imports

Create graphify.json at project root - a task dependency graph JSON file with nodes (task IDs, status, description) and edges (dependencies between tasks). Initialize with all planned tasks as 'pending' nodes. Include metadata fields: lastUpdated, currentTask, completedTasks[], blockedTasks[]
Create scripts/update-graphify.ts - a simple Node script that updates graphify.json task status (marks task complete, updates edges, sets next available tasks)

Update package.json scripts: add 'lint': 'biome check .', 'lint:fix': 'biome check --write .', 'format': 'biome format --write .', 'graphify': 'npx tsx scripts/update-graphify.ts', 'test': 'vitest run', 'test:watch': 'vitest'
Create tsconfig.json path aliases: @/* maps to src/*, ensure strict mode is on
Create vitest.config.ts with React plugin, jsdom environment, path aliases matching tsconfig
Create .gitignore with node_modules, .next, .env*.local, storage/ (but not storage/.gitkeep), dist/

Create the directory structure: src/app/, src/components/ui/, src/components/layout/, src/components/shared/, src/lib/db/, src/lib/auth/, src/lib/storage/, src/lib/validators/, src/lib/mock-data/, src/server/routers/, src/server/services/, src/hooks/, src/stores/, src/styles/, storage/.gitkeep, scripts/
Create src/lib/utils.ts with cn() utility using clsx + tailwind-merge
Verify: run 'npm run lint' passes, 'npm run build' succeeds, graphify.json is valid JSON with all task nodes
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds without errors
npm run lint (Biome) passes with no errors
graphify.json exists at root with all task nodes defined as pending
No ESLint config files exist - only Biome
All specified directories exist under src/
vitest.config.ts is configured and 'npm run test' command works (even if no tests yet)
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm it exits 0
Run 'npm run lint' and confirm it exits 0
Run 'cat graphify.json | node -e "process.stdin.resume(); process.stdin.on('data', d => { JSON.parse(d); console.log('valid') })"' to verify valid JSON
findings: Node.js 22 installed via mise (MISE_NODE_VERIFY=false needed due to missing gpg-agent). Biome 2.x has different config schema than 1.x (no organizeImports top-level, uses assist.actions.source.organizeImports instead; files uses 'includes' not 'ignore'; CSS needs tailwindDirectives: true in parser). create-next-app rejects uppercase directory names so used temp-proj workaround. vitest run needs --passWithNoTests flag to exit 0 when no test files exist. graphify.json FEAT-001 marked complete via the graphify script.
